items.text: Version number 1.0.20260513_0641_19_224059 Steam
Today’s update marks the release of VR for Steam! We provided some tips & tricks on how to best experience the game in VR.

Please note that mods are not officially supported in this game and that running them can contribute to crashes and gameplay features breaking. Play at your own risk when using mods. When troubleshooting, always check your mods first.
To kick-start you in your virtual reality experience, there’s a few things you need to know about the VR port of FNAF:SOTM

The VR port does not support room-scale play. Stay within your player boundary and use in-game locomotion controls to navigate. Leaving your boundary and physically walking around will cause interactions to fail.
VR port includes settings specific to this mode. But there’s another setting you’ll need to adjust yourself outside the game.

To adjust the in-game FPS for PC VR, Steam Link and Index users must change the "refresh rate (hz)" in SteamVR settings. Quest Link/Air Link users can adjust it via the Meta Horizon Link desktop app's "Graphics Preferences." Always consider your PC specs' limits when increasing the refresh rate.

If you can’t reach 120/144 Hz in PC VR, try turning SteamVR’s “motion smoothing” setting off.Sometimes deleting the entire “configs” folder (i.e., C:\\Users\\%USERNAME%\\AppData\\Local\\FNAF_SOTM\\Saved\\Config) helps.
More haptic feedback have been implemented across the game, especially for Steam Flat
Lowered the default gamma for better spookiness
Added dynamic resolution

The team would like to provide a small list of known issues. We intend to fix these issues in a later patch, but for now, we have found workarounds in the event you encounter them.

A known flat-specific soft-lock issue causes the elevator to the Manager’s Hallway to link to FPS: the higher your FPS, the smaller the elevator door opens when it breaks down. If your FPS exceeds 600, the door closes entirely upon breaking down. To bypass this, temporarily cap your FPS and enable v-sync.

A known VR-specific issue where pausing specifically while in the Springlock Suit in the beginning of the Doll Hospital can affect the Pause Screen functionality. This may also cause the VR hands to become invisible as well. Simply relaunching the game will fix this.
A known flat-specific issue where pausing during the NG+ Redeemed Ending displays a black-screen. This is not a soft-lock as simply waiting a few minutes will take you back to the Main Menu.
A known VR-specific issue on the Dark Ride (to Retail Showroom) where the camera can momentarily go off-center if you are not looking forward. It will fix itself at the end of the ride.

A known VR-specific issue for the Steam Link app users where the player position is off-center and won’t reset. The workaround is to keep your head still during any and all loading screens, transitions, and on startup launch.

A known VR-specific issue where the transition to the Storage Area security office from end of Jackie’s Chase can stay on a black-screen. It’s a very small chance. The workaround is to pause/unpause the game.
A known flat-specific issue where your control input is not locked during loading screens.
There is a very small chance of a soft-lock where the catwalks lift in the Welcome Show/Goodbye Show would not work. If you encounter this issue, please shoot us an email at
contact@steelwoolgames.com and provide your save file C:\\Users\\%USERNAME%\\AppData\\Local\\FNAF_SOTM\\Saved\\SaveGames. This will help us debug!
A known issue where Star Brights can be visually oriented incorrectly on the pedestals.
A known issue where the Big Top Showroom doors leading up to Rooftops could open early without completing all 3 mini-games.
A known issue where trying to destructively force enter a Springlock Suit after opening the R&D office where F10-N4 is can soft-lock you.

Hey all! We promised we would be better about communication moving forward and we want to live up to that. We have decided that we are going to hold back PCVR a LITTLE bit longer. Instead of launching it and then doing a quick turnaround patch (our original plan), we are going to roll in the patch fixes and updates directly to the PCVR launch build. We are also going to incorporate fixes to some of the main issues we’re seeing in the current community playthroughs.

Our goal is to launch a higher quality PCVR edition and then patch the PS VR2 version so there is complete parity between the two platforms. We are working hard with our porting partners at Devoted Studios with the goal of getting the PCVR launch and PS VR2 patch ready within the next 2 weeks!

We know it's frustrating when it appears that we aren't communicating and that can come across as if we’re not paying attention. That cannot be farther from the truth. We take this community very seriously because the community is what makes everything we do worthwhile. While I wish we could always be perfect, we do always strive to do better!

⚠️Please read these patch notes with caution as THERE ARE SPOILERS! If you wish to read the more generalized/less-spoilery version, you can read our previous post to the community → https://www.steelwoolstudios.com/announcements/upcominghotfix1

⚠️ Please make sure that you meet the minimum spec requirements for PC (Steam/EGS) AND that you have your graphics card drivers updated! A lot of min-spec & higher spec players have been able to resolve their at-launch crashes after updating their graphics card drivers & Windows. For further clarification, if you have:
An NVIDIA graphics card, you should have the NVIDIA “GeForce Experience” app installed with the latest available “GeForce Game Ready Driver” on the DRIVERS tab.
An AMD graphics card, you should have the “AMD App” installed as it will auto-detect and follow along their instructions.

⚠️ We did put in a fix for the Welcome Show doors never opening for some players. It may still take around 5 mins for players who are UNDER the minimum PC specs(and/or PC hardware is not fully updated - see above). Please note that your experience further in the game will not meet expectations if you fall under the minimum requirement.

issues.text: The team would like to provide a small list of known issues. We intend to fix these issues in a later patch, but for now, we have found workarounds in the event you encounter them.

A known flat-specific soft-lock issue causes the elevator to the Manager’s Hallway to link to FPS: the higher your FPS, the smaller the elevator door opens when it breaks down. If your FPS exceeds 600, the door closes entirely upon breaking down. To bypass this, temporarily cap your FPS and enable v-sync.

A known VR-specific issue where pausing specifically while in the Springlock Suit in the beginning of the Doll Hospital can affect the Pause Screen functionality. This may also cause the VR hands to become invisible as well. Simply relaunching the game will fix this.
A known flat-specific issue where pausing during the NG+ Redeemed Ending displays a black-screen. This is not a soft-lock as simply waiting a few minutes will take you back to the Main Menu.
A known VR-specific issue on the Dark Ride (to Retail Showroom) where the camera can momentarily go off-center if you are not looking forward. It will fix itself at the end of the ride.

A known VR-specific issue for the Steam Link app users where the player position is off-center and won’t reset. The workaround is to keep your head still during any and all loading screens, transitions, and on startup launch.

A known VR-specific issue where the transition to the Storage Area security office from end of Jackie’s Chase can stay on a black-screen. It’s a very small chance. The workaround is to pause/unpause the game.
A known flat-specific issue where your control input is not locked during loading screens.
There is a very small chance of a soft-lock where the catwalks lift in the Welcome Show/Goodbye Show would not work. If you encounter this issue, please shoot us an email at
contact@steelwoolgames.com and provide your save file C:\\Users\\%USERNAME%\\AppData\\Local\\FNAF_SOTM\\Saved\\SaveGames. This will help us debug!
A known issue where Star Brights can be visually oriented incorrectly on the pedestals.
A known issue where the Big Top Showroom doors leading up to Rooftops could open early without completing all 3 mini-games.
A known issue where trying to destructively force enter a Springlock Suit after opening the R&D office where F10-N4 is can soft-lock you.
